note: Targets from docs/PLAN.md, committed before the final benchmark run and not changed after it. The planner measured is the claude CLI (claude -p, Haiku 5.5): it is the only planner this build has, because there is no API provider and no key. Each call spawns a process, so the latency targets were written for a direct API call and are expected to be missed; they are reported as missed, not relaxed.

targets.name: Model calls per complex task, median
